en: Nehemiah 11

p.src: 1  The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

en: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
u.src: 1  The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

p.src: 2  The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

en: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
u.src: 2  The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

p.src: 3  Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

ja: 、宮のしもべたち、ソロモンのしもべたちの
en: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
u.src: 3  Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

p.src: 4  Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

ja: エルサレムには、ユダの
らのうちでは、ペレツの
であるマハラレルの子シェファテヤの子アマルヤの子ゼカリヤの子ウジヤの
en: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
u.src: 4  Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

p.src: 5  and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

ja: また、シロ人の子孫であるゼカリヤの子ヨヤリブの子アダヤの子ハザヤの子コル・ホゼの子バルクの
en: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
u.src: 5  and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

p.src: 6  All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

en: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.
u.src: 6  All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

p.src: 7  These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

ja: のとおりである。エシャヤの子イティエルの子マアセヤの子コラヤの子ペダヤの子ヨエドの子メシュラムの
en: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
u.src: 7  These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

p.src: 8  After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

en: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
u.src: 8  After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

p.src: 9  Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

en: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
u.src: 9  Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

p.src: 10  Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

ja: のうちでは、ヨヤリブの
en: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
u.src: 10  Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

p.src: 11  Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,

ja: メライオテの子ザドクの子メシュラムの
セラヤ。彼は神の家の長であった。
en: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,

p.src: 12  and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

ja: 。さらに、マルキヤの子パシュフルの子ゼカリヤの子アムジの子ペラルヤの子エロハムの
en: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
u.src: 12  and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

p.src: 13  and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

ja: 。また、イムルの子メシレモテの子アフザイの子アザルエルの
en: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
u.src: 13  and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

p.src: 14  and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

en: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
u.src: 14  and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

p.src: 15  Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

ja: のうちでは、ブニの子ハシャビヤの子アズリカムの子ハシュブの
en: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
u.src: 15  Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

p.src: 16  and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

ja: たちのうち、神の家の外務を監督したシャベタイとヨザバド。
en: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;
u.src: 16  and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

p.src: 17  and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

ja: また、アサフの子ザブディの子ミカの
マタヌヤ。彼は祈りで感謝を唱える際の先導者であった。さらに、
で第二の者バクブクヤと、エドトンの子ガラルの子シャムアの
en: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
u.src: 17  and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

p.src: 18  All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

en: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
u.src: 18  All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

p.src: 19  Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

ja: 衛は、アクブ、タルモン、および
で見張りをした彼らの
en: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
u.src: 19  Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

p.src: 20  The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

en: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
u.src: 20  The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

p.src: 21  But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

ja: 宮のしもべたちはオフェルに
み、ツィハとギシュパが宮のしもべたちを
en: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
u.src: 21  But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

p.src: 22  The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

ja: エルサレムにおけるレビ
ウジであった。ウジはハシャビヤの
の歌うたいたちに属していた。
en: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.
u.src: 22  The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

p.src: 23  For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

ja: うたいたちについては
en: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
u.src: 23  For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

p.src: 24  Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

ja: のもとで取り次ぐ者であった。
en: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
u.src: 24  Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

ja: 々について言えば、ユダの
は、キルヤテ・アルバとその
の町、エカブツェエルとその
en: As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
u.src: 25  As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

p.src: 26  in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

ja: エシュア、モラダ、ベテ・ペレト、
en: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,
u.src: 26  in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

p.src: 27  in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,

ja: ハツァル・シュアル、ベエル・シェバとその
en: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,
u.src: 27  in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,

p.src: 28  in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,

u.src: 28  in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,

p.src: 29  in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

en: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
u.src: 29  in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

らはベエル・シェバからヒンノムの

u.src: 30  Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

p.src: 32  at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

en: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
